name: Lost Island 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Lost Island 3 is a bubble shooter game. Travel through this mysterious island that is home to an ominous bubble snake. Your objective is to keep the bubble snake from reaching its destination. To do this, use the bubble cannons to aim at shoot at the snake’s body. Create groups of 3 or more bubbles of the same color to make them disappear. There are obstacles that may prevent you from getting a clear shot so wait patiently but strike quickly when the coast is clear. When you split up the snake, it will slowly reconnect giving you a chance to aim at more parts of its bubbly body. There are 20 levels for you to play in this online game. Submit your score at the end of the game to see how well you did compare to other bubble shooter players. Play this game on mobile or your computer.
